Game Overview

In Lava Blox, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the fiery challenge of Lava Blox, a thrilling 3D platformer set in a lava-drenched dungeon. Leap between moving blocks, utilize boost pads, and dodge deadly spikes. Unlock slick suits with collected coins as you navigate 15 intense levels filled with shifting platforms and crucial Access Cards.
